scores.summary: Justifications are generic labels ('COTS', 'buy-in components', 'standard products') with no £/unit, £/kg, £/hr, or supplier-level anchoring; assumption blocks exist but omit volume, NRE horizon, BOM source, tariffs, and lead times throughout.
scores.nextFix: Require each costJustification to cite at least three concrete figures (e.g. '160 LED bars @ £820/bar ex-Shenzhen landed, 4 hr assembly @ £45/hr, £1,200 driver NRE amortised over 50 units') and each assumptions block to declare annual build volume, BOM source region, NRE amortisation horizon, and any applicable import tariffs.

scores.summary: Justifications are generic one-liners with no £/kg, £/hr, tooling-amortisation, or supplier-region data; assumption blocks exist but lack concrete volume figures, NRE horizons, BOM sources, or tariff treatment.
scores.nextFix: Require each costJustification to cite at minimum: (a) a named material cost in £/kg or £/unit, (b) an explicit labour rate in £/hr and estimated hours, (c) tooling NRE amortised over a stated annual volume, and (d) supplier region — e.g. 'Ash billet £4.20/kg × 0.18 kg + CNC machining 22 min @ £65/hr + 10% scrap = £9.14 material+labour; no tooling (machined not moulded); UK supplier, no tariff uplift'.

scores.summary: Justifications are generic module-level labels with no cited £/kg material costs, tooling amortisation figures, supplier names, or labour-hour breakdowns; assumption blocks exist but are thin, inconsistent across modules, and omit NRE horizons, tariffs, lead times, and BOM sourcing detail.
scores.nextFix: Require each module's costJustification to include: (a) dominant BOM line items with unit £ prices and source (e.g. 'SoC £38.50 @ Mouser UK, 1k qty'), (b) labour hours × £/hr rate, (c) tooling/NRE £ amortised over stated volume, and (d) any tariff or logistics uplift — and mandate the same structured fields in every assumptions block (annual volume, supplier region, NRE horizon, BOM date).

scores.summary: Justifications name the dominant cost driver per module but lack £/hr labour rates, £/kg material rates, volume tiers, NRE amortisation, and supplier-region context; assumption blocks are present but thin and inconsistently populated across modules.
scores.nextFix: Require every module to state: (a) assumed annual build volume, (b) named supplier or region with lead-time, (c) explicit labour rate in £/hr and hours broken out by task, (d) material cost in £/kg or £/unit with source date, and (e) NRE/tooling amortisation horizon — penalise any module that omits these five fields.

scores.summary: Justifications are generic one-liners ('COTS components plus custom skid') with no £/kg, £/hr, BOM line-item, or supplier-quote anchoring; assumption blocks exist but contain only qualitative labels rather than concrete values (volumes, lead times, tariff rates, NRE horizons).
scores.nextFix: Require the model to output a mini-BOM per module (material description, quantity, unit £, source/supplier, labour hours × £/hr rate, NRE amortised over stated annual volume) so every totalPerUnit is arithmetically traceable rather than asserted.
